title: The Last Little Sound
synopsis: Friends from both sides of the valley read Ben’s five pages at Story House, discover a final paper sound, and shelve the completed book.
continuity_state: Before: Five blue-notebook pages complete; Todd and Wendy have met; remaining page is blank; Ben owns the book. After: Sixth page depicts the sound of unfolding Amy’s map; completed Book of Little Sounds rests on the low Story House shelf with Ben’s permission to borrow it again; everyone returns home; lantern and banner remain in established places.
